parsed.summary: Engaged Singaporean couples who are first‑time applicants can apply for a BTO, provided they meet the standard eligibility criteria and have a valid HFE.

claims.text: First‑time couples (married or engaged) who are both Singapore Citizens and have never owned a flat or received a housing subsidy are eligible to apply for a BTO.
All first‑time applicants must hold a valid HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter before submitting a BTO application.
Apply for an HFE letter via the HDB Flat Portal; the process typically takes up to 14 days.
Gather the required documents, such as NRICs, latest income documents (e.g., payslips or CPF statements), and the HFE letter.
Check that both applicants meet the minimum age requirement (21 years old) and are not barred from HDB purchases.
Exact income ceiling limits and grant eligibility can change; verify the latest figures on hdb.gov.sg before applying.
